text:
rosa m.: hello! first day here. trying to register my YubiKey for Okta WebAuthn but the setup flow errors: 'WebAuthn not permitted for your org'. also 1Password SSO is asking to add a security key and then failing. anyone know if we support hardware keys?
it-support: welcome, rosa! we do support WebAuthn but only after your account has the "webauthn-allowed" flag and the 1Password app assignment. sounds like provisioning missed that bit. can you confirm you're using rosa.m@redwood.com and that you clicked the onboarding email link?
rosa m.: yep rosa.m@redwood.com, clicked the invite earlier today. i can sign into Okta but when I try to "Add a security key" it immediately shows that error.
security: tagging infra-admin. quick note: we encourage security keys but require policy enrollment to map keys to users and disallow cross-org keys until registration completes. fallback is Okta Verify + backup codes so you can finish onboarding.
infra-admin: checked SCIM and app assignments. your user was created but the "webauthn-allowed" attribute wasn't set due to a rule mismatch (new-hire OU). i've updated your profile, added you to the "employees" group and assigned 1Password (SSO) + Google Workspace. i've also enabled WebAuthn for your user and resent the 1Password invite. try the key setup again.
it-support: if you still hit the error, try: 1) clear cookies or use incognito, 2) plug in the YubiKey then click "Add security key", 3) when prompted press the key. on mac, make sure you allow browser access to USB devices.
rosa m.: ok tried in incognito, got a browser prompt for the key, tapped it and it registered! then 1Password SSO accepted the key during setup and didn't ask for a master password. Google Workspace SSO works too.
security: great. one more thing: generate Okta recovery codes and store them in 1Password as a secure note in the "Personal - Security" vault. also consider adding a second device (phone or second key) as backup.
it-support: delivered. i've added a one-off ticket to enable "webauthn-allowed" for new hires to avoid this gap. thanks for flagging.
onboarding-bot: Welcome to Redwood, rosa! :wave: Checklist updated: Okta + WebAuthn registered, Google Workspace access confirmed, 1Password SSO complete. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/internal/onboarding/webauthn and https://redwood.example.com/internal/onboarding/1password-sso
rosa m.: thanks everyone  all green. one small Q: where do we file lost-key replacements?
it-support: open a support ticket with "lost key" and we'll deprovision and reissue access policies. if you lose a key, use your recovery codes to log in first then request deprovision. Docs link: https://redwood.example.com/internal/security/lost-webauthn
rosa m.: got it, will add a backup key. excited to be here! :tada:
